rationale: Y engages directly with the same code region as the ground truth's critical hang-bug finding (validate-before-collectives placement), independently explains why the qwen-sampling test is weak (monkeypatch masks a probe/decode frame-count mismatch), and matches the PR's extensive T2VA-threshold saga with commit-level archaeology — plus it verifies the AAC fix by actually running the code. X never surfaces the hang bug or the weak-test issue, and pads its report with three near-duplicate B300/H100 hardware findings not raised by any human reviewer. Both are reasonably diff-grounded, but Y's findings are more concrete (code-level fixes, specific constants) and closer to what the actual reviewers cared about.
